commands.name: ry-deploy
commands.description: Деплой с sync/checks/логами/fix-forward/финализацией. Deploy with local↔GitHub↔server sync, log verification, fix-forward, and docs/git finalization.

commands.name: ry-design
commands.description: Сквозной дизайн-воркфлоу: Figma + tokens + FSD + shadcn/ui + browser validation. Run end-to-end design workflow.

commands.name: ry-explore
commands.description: Глубокое исследование через ry-explore (Opus, max effort). Run deep multi-source research.

commands.name: ry-init
commands.description: Инициализация scoped read-only контекста проекта: Serena discovery + fullrepo bootstrap + verified context pack. Initialize scoped project context.

commands.name: ry-newp
commands.description: Проектирование нового проекта: скептические вопросы → research → архитектура docs → optional scaffold. Plan a new project with skeptical questions and research.

commands.name: ry-repair
commands.description: Нормализовать репозиторий: source-of-truth scan, semantic entropy audit, technical repairs, validators, docs/memory sync. Repair stale AI-tool context and contracts.

commands.name: ry-review
commands.description: Глубокое report-only ревью diff/PR/scope с reviewer tracks (architecture/quality/consistency/integration/verification/security). Deep review with parallel reviewer tracks.

commands.name: ry-rules-review
commands.description: Аудит реализации против rldyour rules. Audit implementation against rldyour rules (report-only).

commands.name: ry-sec-review
commands.description: Защитный security review: OWASP Top 10, auth/authz, injection, secrets. Defensive Mythos-style security review.

commands.name: ry-start
commands.description: Полный lifecycle задачи: init → research → plan → implement → quality gates → post-task sync; review only when explicitly requested. Full task lifecycle from prompt to synced state.

commands.name: ry-sync
commands.description: Синхронизация Serena memories, AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md, git и fullrepo после meaningful работы. Synchronize memories, docs, git state and fullrepo branch.
